title: Derived & related physical constants as Facets (CODATA 2022)
description: Each entry is a Facet: one measurable face of physical law, derived from the defining constants of the SI. Where /2 (Structures) held the primary standing constants, /3 (Facets) holds the derived faces they present — coupling strengths, spectroscopic scales, and quantum-electrical ratios.

provenance.primary_source: CODATA 2022 recommended values (Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga)
provenance.note: Values transcribed from authoritative public sources. Exact/defined faces are flagged exact=true; measured faces carry a standard uncertainty. FACT vs MODEL kept distinct.
